notebooks.title: 复算四种惯量的响应与裕度
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import control as ctrl
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import signal

def peak(num, den):
    # |H(jw)|^2 is a real rational function of x=w^2.
    def mag2(poly):
        a=np.asarray(poly)[::-1]*(1j**np.arange(len(poly)))
        return np.polynomial.polynomial.polymul(a, np.conj(a)).real[::2]
    n,d=mag2(num),mag2(den)
    P=np.polynomial.polynomial
    derivative=P.polysub(P.polymul(P.polyder(n),d),P.polymul(n,P.polyder(d)))
    roots=P.polyroots(P.polytrim(derivative,tol=1e-15))
    xs=[0.0]+[float(r.real) for r in roots if abs(r.imag)<1e-7*max(1,abs(r.real)) and r.real>0]
    candidates=[(float(np.sqrt(max(0,P.polyval(x,n)/P.polyval(x,d)))),float(np.sqrt(x))) for x in xs]
    limit=abs(num[0]/den[0]) if len(num)==len(den) else 0.0
    return max(candidates+[(limit,float('inf'))],key=lambda a:a[0])

b=.1
Kp,Ki,Kd=50.,10.,.5
s=ctrl.tf('s')
C=Kp+Ki/s+Kd*s
G0=1/(.01*s*s+b*s)
L0=C*G0
D0=[.01,.6,50,10]
N0=[.5,50,10]
w=np.logspace(-2,4,1601)

cells.code:
t=np.linspace(0,2,20001)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4))
load_results=[]
for J in [.005,.01,.05,.1]:
    G=1/(J*s*s+b*s)
    L=C*G
    T=ctrl.feedback(L)
    tt,y=ctrl.step_response(T,T=t)
    gm,pm,_,wc=ctrl.margin(L)
    overshoot=100*(np.max(y)-1)
    load_results.append([J,float(pm),float(overshoot),float(wc)])
    print(f"J={J:.3f} PM={pm:.6f} deg OS_0_2s={overshoot:.6f}% wc={wc:.6f} rad/s GM_factor={gm} GM_dB={20*np.log10(gm)}")
    axes[0].plot(tt,y,label=f'J={J}')
    axes[1].semilogx(w,20*np.log10(abs(L(1j*w))),label=f'J={J}')
for ax in axes:
    ax.grid(True);ax.legend()
axes[0].set(xlim=(0,2),ylim=(0,2.5),xlabel='Time (s)',ylabel='Angle (rad)')
axes[1].set(xlim=(.01,1e4),ylim=(-100,150),xlabel='Frequency (rad/s)',ylabel='Loop magnitude (dB)')
axes[1].axhline(0,color='black',linestyle='--')
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('Routh_J_upper_strict', (b+Kd)*Kp/Ki)
